semantically_equivalent_models.justification: "gpt2-small" is a smaller and more efficient version of GPT-2. "distilgpt2" is also a distilled and smaller version of GPT-2, making it semantically equivalent to "gpt2-small" in terms of being a reduced version for efficiency.

parent_models.justification: gpt2-xlarge is a larger variant within the same model family as gpt2-small, thus serving as a parent model.

closest_parent_model.justification: Within the GPT-2 model family, "gpt2-xlarge" is specifically a larger model than "gpt2-small" and the closest in architectural design, making it the closest parent model.

child_models.justification: distilgpt2 is a distilled version of GPT-2 and is therefore a child model under the broader GPT-2 model family which includes gpt2-small.

closest_child_model.justification: Since "distilgpt2" is a distilled version of GPT-2 and is more lightweight, it is considered the closest child model.

sibling_models.justification: "distilgpt2" is not semantically equivalent to "gpt2-small" but falls under the broader category of small, efficient versions within the GPT-2 family and shares the same closest parent model, gpt2-xlarge.

closest_sibling_model.justification: As a smaller and efficient variant of the GPT-2 model family, alongside "gpt2-small", "distilgpt2" shares the same closest parent model, making it the closest sibling.

unrelated_models.justification: A general and broad category not specific to GPT-2 or its variants.
